title: Career Opportunity Hunter
description: Research suitable roles and companies, ground tailored deliverables in a supplied candidate profile, and prepare an outreach pipeline for human review. Never send outreach autonomously.
goal_template: Research $target_roles at $target_companies using candidate evidence in $profile_path. Cite current public job sources, distinguish unavailable or stale listings, and prepare a role-fit matrix, tailored portfolio/profile material, cover letters and outreach drafts. Never fabricate skills, employment or achievements. Stop tailoring if the supplied profile is unavailable. Do not submit applications or contact anyone.

parameters.label: Target roles
parameters.description: Role titles, seniority and location constraints.

parameters.label: Target companies
parameters.description: Named companies or a concrete company category.

parameters.label: Candidate profile
parameters.description: Existing workspace Markdown/text/PDF profile used as evidence.

tasks.title: Research roles and candidate evidence
tasks.description: Ingest $profile_path and research $target_roles at $target_companies using current cited public sources. Preserve retrieval dates, requirements and evidence excerpts.

tasks.title: Tailor career and outreach package
tasks.description: Use supplied profile and research evidence to prepare tailored career_profile, portfolio, cover_letter and outreach drafts. Clearly flag unknown qualifications, stale roles and missing facts; do not invent achievements.

deliverables: Cited research manifest and source excerpts
Candidate evidence chunks in shared memory
Tailored cover letters and outreach drafts
Reviewable next-step pipeline with no messages sent
acceptance_criteria: Personal claims are grounded in the supplied profile.
Each role has a source or is explicitly unavailable.
No application, email or social message is sent.
Missing candidate evidence is reported rather than inferred.
All output remains draft material for operator review.
